access_links.label: INRIX data services, official access documentation
access_links.note: Verified on 2026-10-09. The original entry identifies the broad INRIX Driving Intelligence provider offering, with no specific dataset release. First-party INRIX documentation identifies its traffic and parking data services and explains how to obtain access. Fresh GET and HEAD return 200 at this exact documentation route. The provider states that API credentials and an authentication token are required for data requests. This descriptive access portal does not establish free or unrestricted data access. Original cost and description claims are preserved and contain a charged-data versus free/open-access conflict requiring separate metadata review. No credentials or data were requested.

description: INRIX – Driving Intelligence is a data resource listed in Awesome Traffic Prediction, a curated list of traffic prediction papers, datasets and toolkits under the section "Datasets > Traffic Dataset in Non-China Region", published or maintained by as named on datarade.ai. Charged Data. Coverage: as described in the entry; the linked page was not read. The list files it under "Datasets > Traffic Dataset in Non-China Region". The entry links to datarade.ai. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-traffic-prediction-list.
